description:
About this space
Stay at Esperanza Homes in our private Ensuite Room, featuring your own attached bathroom! Located in Bulawayo, we offer a secure, cozy retreat. Enjoy a comfortable double bed and access to a modern shared kitchen and free parking. Perfect for solo travelers or couples seeking privacy and value. Experience warm hospitality and a restful sleep in your home away from home.

The space
Welcome to Esperanza Homes - Where Luxury Meets Comfort in Bulawayo

Experience the perfect blend of modern amenities and warm hospitality in the heart of Barham Green. Whether you're traveling solo or with company, Esperanza Homes offers a serene retreat with everything you need for a comfortable stay.

Accommodation:

Choose from our 5 beautifully appointed bedrooms:
- 2 Ensuite Rooms: Private luxury with your own bathroom featuring shower, bathtub, and toilet. One room has a queen-size bed, the other a comfortable double bed.
- 3 Standard Rooms: Cozy doubles with access to well-maintained shared facilities including a full bathroom (shower, tub, toilet) plus a separate guest toilet for added convenience.

Room Features:
- 32-inch Smart TV with open view in every room
- Fresh linens and comfortable bedding
- Ample natural light and bright, welcoming spaces

Property Amenities:

Uninterrupted Comfort: Solar backup power, gas geysers for instant hot water 24/7, and dual water supply (borehole + council water) ensure you never experience disruptions.

Stay Connected: Unlimited high-speed WiFi throughout the property.

Self-Catering Kitchen: Fully equipped communal kitchen for preparing your meals at your convenience.

Personalized Service: Our friendly housekeeper and receptionist, Siphenduliwe, assists with check-in and is available to help make your stay seamless.

Located in the peaceful and secure Barham Green neighborhood, Esperanza Homes is your ideal home away from home in Bulawayo.

Guest access
As an ensuite guest, you'll enjoy:

Private Spaces:
- Your own bedroom with lock for privacy and security
- Private ensuite bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet) - no sharing required
- Personal 32-inch Smart TV

Shared Spaces:
- Full access to the communal kitchen equipped with appliances, cookware, and utensils
- Outdoor spaces and garden areas
- Parking facilities

Utilities & Amenities:
- Unlimited WiFi throughout the property
- 24/7 hot water via gas geysers
- Solar backup ensuring uninterrupted power

On-Site Support:
Siphenduliwe, our housekeeper and receptionist, is available during business hours to assist with any needs or questions.

You'll have the perfect balance of private retreat and shared spaces, ideal for both relaxation and socializing with other guests if you choose.

During your stay
During Your Stay

If you need any assistance, have questions, or require anything during your stay, please contact:

Siphenduliwe Mlotshwa
Housekeeper & Receptionist

Siphenduliwe is available on-site to help with:
- Check-in and check-out procedures
- Questions about the property and amenities
- Local recommendations and directions
- Any maintenance or housekeeping needs
- General assistance to make your stay comfortable

We're here to ensure you have a wonderful stay at Esperanza Homes!

Other things to note
House Type
- This is a private room in a shared guesthouse, not an entire property
- Bathroom is ensuite (private to your room)
- Kitchen, common areas, and grounds are shared with other guests

What's Not Included
- Meals are not provided
- Personal toiletries (bring your own)

Emergency contact number provided upon booking confirmation
